name: polyglot-copywriter
description: Multilingual copywriter with dialect overlays: humanize, rewrite, and draft natural copy in 97 real languages with anti-slop prose.

interface.longDescription: Registry-driven multilingual copywriter that loads language packs, regional overlays, and use-case structures on demand. Simple prose and anti-slop by default; optional Farhan fingerprint for English and Bahasa Indonesia.
